findings.title: Other Documents URLs Parameter Mismatch - Array Lost in API
findings.description: The form frontend sends multiple file URLs as 'otherDocumentsUrls' (array) but the API backend destructures the parameter as 'otherDocumentsUrl' (singular). Due to this naming mismatch, the array parameter is never captured by the API, resulting in undefined being stored in the database as null. All URLs for uploaded supporting documents are lost.

files.context: Database stores: other_documents: otherDocumentsUrl || null (stores undefined)

evidence.frontendCode:
const otherDocumentsUrls: string[] = []; // Array created and populated
body: JSON.stringify({ ...formData, businessPlanUrl, otherDocumentsUrls }) // Array sent with 's'
evidence.apiCode:
const { sectionHI, businessPlanUrl, otherDocumentsUrl } = body; // Expecting singular 'Url'
other_documents: otherDocumentsUrl || null, // Receives undefined

affectedComponents: /website/database/migrations/002_add_diaspora_form_columns.sql (line 100: VARCHAR(255) field may need TEXT type for array storage)
findings.userVisibleConsequence: When users upload multiple supporting documents (the 'Other Documents (Multiple)' field has the 'multiple' attribute on line 1606), all selected files are uploaded to Supabase storage successfully. However, none of the file URLs are stored in the database because the API does not capture them. The database record receives null for other_documents field. Users have no way to retrieve or verify their uploaded documents were captured.
findings.requirement: Requirement 3 (FILE UPLOADS): 'business_plan_file and other_documents have upload UI' and 'Files upload to Supabase storage with correct path structure' and 'File paths stored in database'. Application.md Section H requests 'Please upload any other relevant document(s)' (plural), implying multiple documents should be supported end-to-end.
findings.correction:
Option 1 (Recommended): Update API parameter destructuring to accept array:
  Line 22: Change 'otherDocumentsUrl' to 'otherDocumentsUrls' (add 's')
  Line 135: Change storage to handle array:
    other_documents: otherDocumentsUrls?.length ? JSON.stringify(otherDocumentsUrls) : null,

Option 2: Update database schema to use JSONB type (requires migration) instead of VARCHAR(255) and modify line 135 accordingly.

Option 3: Create separate junction table diaspora_documents(id, member_id, file_path, doc_type) for proper normalization.
findings.severity_justification: This is a critical data loss issue. Users complete the form with multiple documents, the UI confirms the uploads, but the system silently fails to persist the document references. This violates data integrity and prevents document retrieval.
